title: Sigen server
description: Sigenergy power, battery, energy, electrical, alerts and exporter health. Select one Prometheus job and instance.

options.content: **Grid:** positive = import, negative = export. **Battery:** positive = charging, negative = discharging. Daily energy follows the device’s local day. Optional telemetry may be unavailable; missing values are not zero. Current values use instant queries at the selected range end. Detailed events live in the server’s event journal.

panels.title: Prometheus scrape
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape this server. Separate from hardware connectivity.

panels.title: Hardware readings
panels.description: Online means the core hardware readings are fresh, not merely that the HTTP server is running.

panels.title: Grid power
panels.description: Positive import; negative export. This is a plant measurement.

panels.title: Battery power
panels.description: Positive charging; negative discharging.

panels.title: Power flows
panels.description: Signed measurements are preserved. Plant active power is not a measurement of household load.

panels.title: Solar today (inverter)
panels.description: Device-local daily total. This gauge resets at device-local midnight; it is not a counter.

panels.title: Load today (plant)
panels.description: Device-local daily total. This gauge resets at device-local midnight; it is not a counter.

panels.title: Battery charged today
panels.description: Device-local daily total. This gauge resets at device-local midnight; it is not a counter.

panels.title: Battery discharged today
panels.description: Device-local daily total. This gauge resets at device-local midnight; it is not a counter.

panels.title: Device-local daily energy totals
panels.description: Raw daily gauges, not rates or sums over the selected range. Resets follow the inverter’s local day.

panels.title: Grid import over selected range
panels.description: Counter increase across the selected time range, adjusted for observed resets and extrapolated by Prometheus. Gaps or sparse observations can reduce accuracy; this is not a billing total.

panels.title: Grid export over selected range
panels.description: Counter increase across the selected time range, adjusted for observed resets and extrapolated by Prometheus. Gaps or sparse observations can reduce accuracy; this is not a billing total.

panels.title: Cumulative grid energy
panels.description: Plant totals since the new statistics interface was initialized, not daily energy. Firmware initialization may reset these counters.

panels.title: Inverter phase voltage
panels.description: Only phases with a defined phase-neutral measurement for the inverter wiring are exported.

panels.title: Grid sensor phase power
panels.description: Plant grid sensor measurements; positive import, negative export. Requires a connected grid sensor.

panels.title: Output wiring
panels.description: Raw output wiring type. Unknown future values remain visible as numbers.

panels.title: Plant EMS work mode
panels.description: Plant EMS work mode and remote control mode are separate register values.

panels.title: Alert state
panels.description: An active alert can remain latched while data is stale. Interpret together with condition-known status.

panels.title: Alert condition known
panels.description: Zero means the condition cannot currently be evaluated. Disabled alerts are known by definition.

panels.title: Raw alarm bitfields
panels.description: Raw register masks for groups 1–5. Zero means no bits set; numeric magnitude does not indicate severity.

panels.title: Poll and control error rate
panels.description: Counter rates handle server restarts. The rate window follows the datasource scrape interval.

panels.title: Availability history
panels.description: MQTT is absent when disabled. Unknown or missing samples are not interpreted as offline or healthy.

panels.title: Core sample age
panels.description: Age measured by the server at the most recent scrape.

panels.title: Poll errors over selected range
panels.description: Prometheus-extrapolated counter increase, adjusted for observed resets; fractional values are possible.

panels.title: Control errors over selected range
panels.description: Prometheus-extrapolated counter increase, adjusted for observed resets; fractional values are possible.

panels.title: Journal integrity
panels.description: Sticky event-loss indicator for this server process; resets on restart. Journal metrics are absent in older versions.

panels.title: Journal records committed
panels.description: Since this server process started; not the total stored journal size.

panels.title: Journal events lost
panels.description: Since this server process started. Storage failures and queue overflow can lose journal events.

panels.title: Pushover accepted over selected range
panels.description: Optional integration. Counts are extrapolated by Prometheus; accepted does not prove delivery to a phone.

panels.title: Pushover failed over selected range
panels.description: Optional integration. Counts are extrapolated by Prometheus; accepted does not prove delivery to a phone.

panels.title: Last Pushover acceptance age
panels.description: Time since the API last accepted a notification. Unavailable until a notification is accepted.
